resources.string: Back up chats
Restore chats

Saves all your chats (Messages, iMessage, WhatsApp and the others), with the pictures and attachments stored on this phone, to one file you choose, encrypted with a passphrase. Keep the file somewhere off this phone, such as a computer or cloud storage.
Your iMessage registration is not in the backup; register again after restoring. Sign-ins and pairings (Google Messages, WhatsApp, Gmail, Discord) and passwords are not in it either.
Without the passphrase nobody can open the backup, not even you: there is no way to recover it.
Restores chats from a file made with Back up chats. This replaces all chats on this phone with the backup.
